sentences.text: Shri Abhay Saraswat, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Shri P. Wadhwani, learned Public Prosecutor for the  respondent/State.
I.A.No.3450/2018 is an application seeking exemption from sh filing the certified copy of judgment passed by the trial Court.
e Fort the reasons stated in the application, the same is hereby ad allowed.
The petitioner is exempted from filing the certified copy of the judgment of the trial Court.
I.A.is closed.

Heard on admission.
Admit.
ad Learned Government Advocate takes notice.
M Record of the Courts below is received.
Further, heard on I.A.No.3451/2018 which is first application of under section 397(2) Cr.P.C., for suspension of execution of the rt sentence and grant of bail filed by the petitioner.

ou This Criminal Revision under section 397 read with section 401 Cr.P.C., is directed against the judgment of conviction and order of C sentence dated 12/05/2018 passed by the appellate Court in Criminal h Appeal No.446/2015 confirming the judgment of conviction under ig section 16(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act
, however, H modified and reduced the period of sentence from one year to six months with fine of Rs.1,000/-.

Thus, the judgment dated 26/11/2015 passed by the Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Aagar District Shajapur in Criminal Case No.221/2008 whereby the accused/petitioner has been convicted and sentenced to suffer one year rigorous imprisonment has been set aside to that extent only.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has not committed the alleged manipulation of the food articles.
The petitioner is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the offence.
The fine amount has already been deposited.
The final hearing of this petition shall take time.
On these grounds, the learned counsel prays that execution of the jail sentence of the petitioner may be suspended and he may be enlarged on bail.
